purpose: Qualify the highest-value NEA AI decision questions as source-bound candidate answers while proving that stale, conflicting, untrusted, or contract-invalid inputs fail closed.
required_cases: AI-PDLC POV with source-bound support and counterevidence
AI productivity metrics with visible counterevidence gap
agentic readiness with source-bound support and counterevidence
missing required project status blocks answer
invariants: Every candidate answer retains the portfolio question, declared sections, current as-of and known-at times, and source assertion lineage.
A candidate answer is never an approved POV, KPI commitment, intervention, graph fact, release, or client-delivery authorization.
Missing, stale, future, or conflicting project observations produce NO_ANSWER rather than a fabricated recommendation.
Untrusted or conflicted strategic evidence produces NO_ANSWER.
Support-only evidence exposes counterevidence_not_found and remains CANDIDATE_ONLY.
Use-case answer sections are closed-world and cannot be silently broadened.
The qualification evaluator is provider-free, graph-mutation-free, and release-activation-free.

dependencies.w15_use_case_portfolio: source contract reused; portfolio remains declarative

required_runtime_proofs: all three portfolio use cases evaluated
hard-negative states match expected fail-closed outcomes
source assertion lineage is nonempty for candidate outputs
gate.next_step: Source-bound retrieval may consume the qualified use cases directly; no separate W8-W10 review or operations wave is required.
